_method_summary: For each read, the fraction of its 10 nearest neighbors (in the morphospace coords) from a DIFFERENT family. MACRO = equal-family average (prevalence-fair). A low per-family rate reflects PREVALENCE (big class -> neighbors are same-class by default), not distinctiveness. At the 'tradition' tier this un-lumps Abrahamic (~97% Christianity) so only the one big class (Christianity) looks clustered. Re-run to regenerate.
reading: MACRO near 100%% = strong interleave; a low per-group rate (the biggest class) reflects PREVALENCE, not content distinctiveness
